# Tattoo ink colour picker (ruler designer) -- generated by harness/tattoo/ink_colour.py.
# Clicks store numbers as globals (the designer preview has no character scope).
# Target: 0 = All tattoos, 1.. = one slot. Hue 0-99, saturation/brightness 1-100.

elf_ink_set_target = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_target value = scope:value }
		elf_ink_load_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_set_hue = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = scope:value }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = 70 } }
		elf_ink_store_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_set_sat = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = scope:value }
		elf_ink_store_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_set_val = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = scope:value }
		elf_ink_store_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_clear = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		elf_ink_clear_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}
